summary: Focused re-test of the Printful image bug (mockup vs print-file) + tonyoga.* dependency removal. Backend: 6/6 pytest checks pass (/app/backend/tests/test_iteration49_images.py) — GET /api/products and GET /api/admin/products return 36 printful products, 19 with images, every images[0] starts with https://files.cdn.printful.com/files/ and ends in _preview.png (mockup); zero 'printfile' URLs used as primary; zero image URLs containing tonyoga.com/tonyoga.online anywhere; product detail endpoint returns mockup and no _id; 3 spot-checked mockup URLs return HTTP 200 with content-type image/*; /api/admin/printful/status reports store 16428293. Frontend: /shop grid loads 19 printful mockup images, 0 broken (naturalWidth>0), 0 printfile/tonyoga URLs; White glossy mug detail page shows the mug mockup. Admin -> Shop & Printful: store selector defaults to 'Tonyoga — woocommerce (36 products)', '36 products synced' badge, 'Begin sync' present+enabled, mockup thumbnails render for physical products; bulk-delete regression verified — checkbox selection updates 'Delete selected (1)' -> 'Delete selected (2)' and the button disappears/disables on deselect (no deletion performed).

issues: The 17 image-less virtual products (subscriptions/holidays/'Core 40', 'Poster Level 1') render as large empty grey rectangles, which reads as a broken/loading image to users. Suggest a branded placeholder (icon + 'Digital / Membership' label) or moving them into a separate non-image list. Cosmetic only — the empty images list itself is expected per spec.
'Core 40' card shows price '$0' — worth confirming the intended price (not part of the image fix, observation only).

action_items: Optional: add a placeholder visual for the 17 image-less virtual products on /shop and in the admin product rows (currently blank grey boxes).
Optional: verify 'Core 40' price of $0 is intentional.
critical_code_review_comments: _normalize() bucketing (mockup -> catalog -> other previews -> print files, no WordPress fallback) is correct and verified end-to-end. The now-unused _img_url() tonyoga.com->tonyoga.online rewriter in /app/backend/routers/printful.py should be deleted if no other caller needs it, to prevent the WordPress dependency creeping back.
seed_data_creation: None — no products created or deleted; bulk delete was only exercised up to the button state (no delete request issued).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Image bug is FIXED and verified (backend + UI). Re-run /app/backend/tests/test_iteration49_images.py as a regression guard; it asserts 36 printful products, printful CDN mockup as images[0], and no tonyoga.* URLs. 17 virtual products with empty images are EXPECTED. Do not call /admin/orders/{id}/fulfill?confirm=true (hits real Printful).
rca_of_the_issue: Previously the storefront picked whichever preview_url came first (often the Printful print file, type='default' = bare artwork) and fell back to the WordPress thumbnail. _normalize now buckets by file type and orders mockup(preview) -> catalog image -> other previews -> print files, with the tonyoga fallback removed. Verified: all 19 physical products serve *_preview.png mockups from files.cdn.printful.com.
